facts.business: The Phoenix Mills Limited develops, owns, and operates retail-led mixed-use destinations including malls, offices, and hospitality assets across India, focusing on long-term value creation through asset densification and reinvestment.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has committed to provide financial support to Starboard Hotels Private Limited and Pallazzio Hotels & Leisure Limited as and when the need arises by infusing required funds. PML has given an unconditional and irrevocable guarantee on behalf of Pallazzio Hotels & Leisure Limited to Starwood Hotels & Resorts India Pvt Ltd amounting to Rs 3,920.60 Lakhs as at 31 March 2026.
